[[Torel Fey'jia]] maintained an underground '''Spynet Facility''' under the [[city/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]] on the [[planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. It was one of the larger [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Spynet]] facilities of the planet, heavily guarded, and accessible through the underground [[Monorail/Legends|unirail]] tunnel.
==Layout==
[[File:spynetmapSOTEPG.jpg|thumb|left|Layout of the facility and the neighboring unirail]]
The facility was located under the [[metal/Legends|metallic]] platform on which Tal'cara was built. Its entrance was behind a Unirail [[Power generator/Legends|Power Generator]] chamber ([[Power coupling/Legends|power couplings]] were used to steal energy from the unirail and power the facility's Listening Room). The easiest entrance to that chamber it was an abandoned warehouse, 400 [[meter/Legends|meters]] to the east.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> 

Fey'jia had purchased that warehouse in the city's [[Warehouse district (Tal'cara)|warehouse district]], in order to keep it that way. It was situated behind an industrial park, and was about the Unirail Commercial Line, with a floor hatch for loading cargo. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[spy/Legends|spies]] carefully maintained its dilapidated look, with scattered [[transcube]]s around. Its doors were well secured with locks, and two [[BT-16 perimeter droid]]s guarded its interior.<ref name="guide" />

Behind the generator room, there was a waiting room, with guards who interrogated any visitors. The actual entrace to the facility itself was a slidable boulder. The roughly hewn cavern corridors before and after the room were rigged with [[LCT laser trip]]s.<ref name="guide" />

The heart of the facility was the immense Main Computer Room, well-equipped with rows of computer terminals and other equipment; the chamber was constantly busy with Bothans and other beings, [[slicer/Legends|slicing]], decrypting and analyzing all kinds of information. To it was adjacent a Power Supply room, and a room with backup computers. A branching corridor led to the Listening Room, equipped with the latest technology—benefitting from the unirail's power generator—and staffed by [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] and slicers, spying on the [[Imperial compound (Kothlis)|Imperial compound]], the [[Bothan Colonial Board]], and the [[Kothlis shadowport]]. The Listening Room's arrays could intercept off-world messages even before they reached their destination on Kothlis.<ref name="guide" />

Other corridors led to the [[barracks/Legends|barracks]], three quarters, and a supply room. All sections were secured with [[blast door/Legends|blast doors]].<ref name="guide" />
==History==
The warehouse belonged to [[MCS]], where Torel managed [[computer/Legends|computers]]. In his free time he used to explore, discovered the old loading hatch in the warehouse; traversing the tunnel, he discovered a power generator chamber west of the hatch, and caves behind it. Stealing energy from the unirail generator, he established a custom computer center there, and moved there permanently. He used his [[slicer/Legends|slicing]] skills to embezzle funds from his employer to support himself, and after it went bankrupt he started his own business buying and selling top-secret corporate information. With his profits he bought the warehouse to ensure it remained in its current state,  and expand and secure the cavern.<ref name="guide" />

Among the visitors of the facility was a band of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[agent/Legends|agents]], looking information on a secret [[v-150_Planet_Defender/Legends|v-150]] [[ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] located on the planet, with the intend to steal some important parts. Torel's slicers took a day or two to find this information during which the Rebels stayed in the facility, sometimes exchanging interesting information with the Bothans.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=Ion Cannon Parts|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>
